lines.text: The genealogy of Jesus Christ runs from Abraham through David and the exile to Babylon to Joseph, Mary's husband.
The generations total three sets of fourteen: Abraham to David, David to the exile, and the exile to the Christ.
Mary, pledged to Joseph, was found with child through the Holy Spirit, so righteous Joseph resolved to quietly divorce her.
An angel appeared to Joseph in the temple courts and said Jesus would save His people from their sins.
The prophet said a virgin would bear a son called Immanuel, meaning God has heard, and Joseph embraced Mary.
